pages.title: A Pocket in a Pocket
pages.text: Install Inception and place one permitted backpack inside another.

pages.title: A Pocket in a Pocket
pages.text: Use permitted nesting without cycles; bases and packing tape help organize a larger move.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Inception permits nesting within native configured limits. Everlasting separately protects the backpack item from destruction/despawn; never sacrifice valuables into the void to test it.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Inception permits nested backpacks under configuration rules; cyclic inventory references or limit bypasses are not gameplay methods.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Everlasting protects the backpack item from destruction/despawn/void loss under native rules. No sacrificial destruction test is required.
